title: Quote aggregation stalls during provider fan-out
summary: Quote requests intermittently return incomplete results during the afternoon traffic peak, while direct provider checks remain responsive.
precursor: Two regional quote providers were added to the aggregation route shortly before a scheduled marketplace campaign.
impact: Customers see delayed or partial quote comparisons, reducing successful quote-to-order conversions.

title: Profile reads fail on newly scheduled gateway replicas
summary: A subset of profile lookups fails before receiving an upstream response, while requests handled by older gateway pods continue to succeed.
precursor: The profile API was rolled out and the gateway deployment was scaled from four replicas to nine during the same release window.
impact: Account pages intermittently lack current contact and preference data, causing avoidable support contacts and retries.

title: Checkout dispatches reach an unavailable inventory listener
summary: Checkout requests that need a stock reservation fail quickly, although the inventory service remains marked ready in the cluster.
precursor: A rolling inventory API update replaced the backing pods after a container image change and a service-port adjustment.
impact: Customers cannot complete purchases for items requiring a fresh reservation, leaving carts open and increasing abandonment.

title: Partner callbacks receive authorization failures in one region
summary: Partner callback deliveries are rejected in the west region while the same partners continue to receive events from the central region.
precursor: The partner integration credentials were rotated during a maintenance window, followed by a staggered rollout of gateway pods.
impact: Shipment status updates arrive late or not at all for affected partners, weakening tracking visibility for customers.

title: Checkout confirmation traffic is throttled after campaign launch
summary: Some customers receive temporary failures when confirming orders, despite healthy payment and inventory dependencies.
precursor: A promotional campaign drove a sharp increase in checkout submissions, and the storefront began retrying transient failures more aggressively.
impact: Order confirmations are delayed or abandoned during the campaign, lowering completed sales and creating duplicate-submission risk.
